class.name: PhysicsIntersectShapeResult2D
class.brief_description: Stores the results of a shape intersection query.
class.description: This class contains the intersection information produced by [method PhysicsDirectSpaceState2D.intersect_shape_into]. It can store multiple intersections, up to a user-defined maximum.

method.name: get_collider_shape
method.description: The shape index of the colliding shape.

method.name: get_intersection_count
method.description: Returns the number of shapes that intersect with the query shape.

members.member: The maximum number of intersections this result object can store.
